instruction:
Start with C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_022_hole_transfer.step in SolidWorks. Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut). For this task, run the SOLIDWORKS automation through `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe` when working on `cli_022_hole_transfer.step`.

Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file with source_plate and target_plate retained as independent solids. The 120 x 80 x 8 mm source_plate contains six 6 mm through holes at relative XY centers (-40,-20), (0,-20), (40,-20), (-40,20), (0,20), and (40,20) from the source_plate center. The 140 x 90 x 8 mm target_plate initially has no holes and is centered at X=125, Y=0. Detect all six through-hole centers on source_plate. Project/copy the same relative XY hole locations to target_plate and cut six 6 mm through holes in target_plate. Do not modify source_plate. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_022_hole_transfer_out.step with both plates retained.
